name: tato-site
description: tatorm.com — sito one-page statico (HTML/CSS/JS vanilla). Build con esbuild.

scripts.build: node scripts/fetch-catalog.mjs && node scripts/fetch-content.mjs && node scripts/build.mjs
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:visual: npm run build && playwright test -c playwright.visual.config.mjs
scripts.test:visual:update: npm run build && playwright test -c playwright.visual.config.mjs --update-snapshots
